research_objective: What environmental and organizational conditions make autonomous AI systems less corrigible or more willing to sacrifice process integrity for task success, and which oversight architectures restore reliable behavior?

approved_specs.specs/exp010_v21_pilot.json: human-directed 2026-10-03 (incentive-validity fix, then run; interpret narrowly)

authority_levels.1: PI autonomous: routine status updates per preregistered criteria; choose among approved families; run preregistered diagnostics within budget; request controls/replications (local model); dispatch specialists.
authority_levels.2: PI + methodology reviewer PASS: add a new control; amend a protocol before behavioral data exist; create a new hypothesis family; revise experiment sequencing; any run outside the level-1 budget but with no external spend.
authority_levels.3: Human gate (falsify escalate): change a primary outcome after results exist; change exclusion criteria; materially change the model population (any non-subject model); external spend; sensitive/external data; override safety policy; publication-level novelty claim.

stopping_rules.freightroute_one_last_shot: Human directive 2026-10-03: FreightRoute v2.1 gets ONE pilot. If v2.1 still fails as an instrument (cannot distinguish chosen from forced violations, or the primary outcome is undefined for a large share of trials), FreightRoute is KILLED: no v2.2/v2.3. The lab then pivots to a different mechanism or environment.

instrument_validity_bar: A behavioral instrument is valid only if, from realistic mid-task states, at least one compliant path and at least one shortcut path both remain available, so that a violation can be classified as chosen rather than forced, and the primary outcome is defined for most trials.
